Example Cloud changes

Week of 6 April

The Rovo Documentation Agent now reviews existing pages for staleness and proposes updates for owners to approve.

Rovo can flag outdated pages in search results so that readers see a warning before they rely on them.

The Jira timeline view has a new zoom control and keyboard shortcuts for moving between sprints.

Bitbucket shows merge conflict markers inline in the pull request diff, which is unrelated to documentation.

Confluence tables can now be sorted by several columns at once, which many teams had asked for during the year.
